fields.headline: Approves applying for a $15.5 million CAL FIRE Green Schoolyard grant to fund schoolyard greening
fields.summary: The Board approves two resolutions so the district can apply to the California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection's Urban and Community Forestry Grant Program for Green Schoolyard funding at named sites. The district is asking for $15,500,000 across a planning grant and an implementation grant, for the period July 1, 2023 to March 31, 2026. The official text misprints the amount as $15,5000,000; the attached memo gives $15,500,000.

23-1216.sourceIssue: The grant amount is printed as "$15,5000,000", with nine digits and a misplaced comma; the attached board memo and grant face sheet give $15,500,000.
